summary: Full backend regression after Reports module addition + server.py refactor cleanup. 144/144 tests passed (8 new reports tests + 136 prior regression tests). The previous iter10 chat-history regression (NameError: require_store_access) is now FIXED — routes/chat.py:10 imports require_store_access and GET /api/chat/messages returns 200. New /api/reports/summary endpoint validated end-to-end: default date range (1st of month → today), explicit date range, employee accounting-hidden, employee blocked from non-allowed store (403), invalid store_id (404), swapped dates auto-corrected, full shopping aggregation (qty=2 × $5 + 10% tax → total_spent=$11.00, total_tax=$1.00, items=1, batches=1, by_supplier=1, by_month=1), and accounting by_head reconciliation against accounting_entries (POST /api/accounting/entry → 25.00 debit reflected in by_head and by_day). entry_total move to helpers.py: zero regressions in accounting routes (all accounting/v3 tests green).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/chat.py — fix for require_store_access import verified (line 10). NameError gone.

routes/reports.py — endpoint structure matches spec: period.from/to, accounting{credit_total/debit_total/net/by_head/by_day/days_with_entries}, shopping{total_spent/total_tax/batches/items/by_supplier/by_month}. Employee view correctly returns accounting={hidden:true}; shopping is fully visible.
Robust input handling: invalid store → 404, unauthorized employee → 403, date_from>date_to → swapped silently, no date params → defaults to month-to-date.
Aggregation correctness verified end-to-end: shopping_list → shopping/execute → shopped_records → reports.summary returns exact $11.00 / $1.00 tax for a 2×$5 @10% scenario.
core/helpers.entry_total — accounting v3 suite (TestAccountingV3) and accounting today/submit endpoints all pass; no regression from extracting entry_total from accounting module to helpers.
seed_data_creation: Test fixtures only — disposable stores/employees/products/suppliers prefixed TEST_, all cleaned up via teardown fixtures. No production data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: export EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://store-manager-pro-9.preview.emergentagent.com && pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/<name>.xml. Full suite ~83s, 144 tests, all green. Reports endpoint at GET /api/reports/summary?store_id=&date_from=YYYY-MM-DD&date_to=YYYY-MM-DD. Employee role gets accounting={hidden:true}; admin sees full breakdown including by_head/by_day. Accounting entries are set via POST /api/accounting/entry {head_id, amount}.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no failures this iteration. Prior iter10 regression (chat NameError) is resolved by the one-line import fix in routes/chat.py.
